title: Adapting neural operators for mechanics decisions under changing operating conditions
summary: Neural operators can accelerate repeated nonlinear mechanics calculations, but their accuracy can deteriorate as operating conditions move beyond the training range. This work studies whether high-fidelity solutions acquired during use can be reused to adapt a neural operator and improve subsequent mechanics-based command selection. Two hard-magnetic soft-material systems are simulated using high-fidelity finite-element (FE) models, providing reference solutions for evaluating surrogate predictions and selected commands.
